name: Elbow Osteoarthritis
definition: Degenerative arthritis of the elbow causing pain, stiffness, osteophytes and possible mechanical impingement, often in patients with heavy repetitive use or prior trauma.

investigations.MRI: CT assists osteophyte/loose-body surgical planning; MRI is less commonly needed.

amber: Injection or debridement/arthroplasty is individualized according to severity and demand.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kurpara Sandhigata Vata correlation may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Degenerative arthritis of the elbow causing pain, stiffness, osteophytes and possible mechanical impingement, often in patients with heavy repetitive use or prior trauma.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, locked joint or other listed red flags.
